decisions.reason: Accepting the machine's current bulk does not change the selected bowl capacity or depth and does not necessarily retract the constraint against an overly large enclosure.
The accepted enclosure bulk and button location do not change any splash-control behavior or mitigation requirement.
The source discusses a possible new base logo, not the machine placard text, position, or dual-sided orientation.
The source does not change the machine or support-base colors.
Acceptance of the current enclosure bulk and button location does not alter the DJ-turntable visual theme.
The source does not change stability, vibration, base, or foot requirements.
The source does not change the off-the-shelf component strategy for the prototype.
Enclosure bulk and button placement do not change the required mixing, frothing, whisk, or high-speed performance.
The source does not change the platform configuration, height, footprint, or cup-clearance purpose.
The accepted bulk is attributed to internal solenoid piping, but the source does not change the spout's geometry, orientation, mounting location, or pour direction.
The source confirms that the client is still exploring an alternative logo without selecting one, so the existing VALUE ambiguity remains accurate and unchanged.
Keeping the spout on/off buttons in their current location does not change their press-and-dispense behavior or any dispensing-flow requirement.
